title: Ishikanwa ryahinduye iherezo
intro: Mu misi ya mbere y’abantu, umutima waratanga ingabirano ufise imigambi myiza. Yamara, ishari ryari ryihishije mu gitutu c’ukwemera. Tora inkuru y’uwo muntu ubusenga bwiwe n’iherezo ryiwe ry’agahomerabunwa bigumaho mu guhishurirwa kw’Imana.
clues: Nari mu mayaruka ya mbere nyene y’abantu.
Nashikaniye Umukama wanje ishikanwa, araryakira neza.
Ishikanwa rya mwenewacu ryaranse, ishari rimugira umwijima mu mutima.
Nanje ndamubwira nti: ‘Niwaramvura ukuboko kugira ngo unyice, sinzokwica; nkako ntinya Allah, Umukama w’isi yose.’
Naciye mba umunyavyaha w’igikorwa ca mbere c’ubwicanyi kw’isi.
Amaraso yanje yaraboroze, nanje mba umumaratiri wa mbere w’ukutagira icaha.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Ishikanwa ryiwe ryaremewe, bituma mwenewabo agirira ishari, aca aramwica .
Yajugunywe mw’itanure ry’umuriro ariko arasohoka ata co akoze .
Yarubatse ubwato amanini cane ayobowe n’Imana .
Yaramizwe n'ifi nini aguma mu mwijima .
Yarongoye abantu biwe mu kiyaga cagabanije .
trial.answer: Ishikanwa ryiwe ryaremewe, bituma mwenewabo agirira ishari, aca aramwica .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Ubwicanyi bwa mbere muri kahise; mwenewabo yaraciriwe urubanza + .
Yahindutse inkyende kubera ukurenga ku mategeko
outcome.answer: Ubwicanyi bwa mbere muri kahise; mwenewabo yaraciriwe urubanza + .

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
